data.notes: Public group page identifies DFW YALL as 'Young Active Labor Leader Dallas -Ft. Worth,' says it was established in 2014 as part of the Dallas AFL-CIO's local effort, and describes its young-worker labor organizing mission. This source establishes the local group's identity; it does not by itself establish participation in the Sept. 10, 2026 march.
